verdict.rationale: Stripe Tax's docs explicitly describe a monitoring feature that tracks transactions against economic nexus thresholds and flags where registration may be needed, matching the core of this story (stripe-tax-docs-17, stripe-tax-docs-7). However, the evidence doesn't specify real-time proactive alerts (e.g., email/notification before a threshold is crossed) versus a dashboard insight reviewed after the fact, and no independent/community corroboration validates this specific feature's accuracy or timeliness. Missing for 10: documented proactive alert/notification mechanism, evidence of pre-threshold warnings vs. retrospective reporting, and independent user validation of nexus-monitoring accuracy across states/countries.
